revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the planning lead framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The sponsor was careful about direction. A companion, prerequisite, approval, or follow-on condition runs only the way the business sentence says it runs; the reverse direction is not part of the deal unless it is stated. The hiring intake now has to fill two roles, Manager and Specialist, rather than just choosing a headcount. Each hired candidate may serve in one role, role headcount limits must be met, managers need the experience floor `min_manager_experience`, and managerial hires contribute the listed `manager_bonus_per_candidate` to the staffing value. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
